description: Manages email, SMS, and in-app notifications. Provides templates for different notification types and handles message formatting and delivery through various channels.

classes.name: NotificationServiceImpl
classes.description: Core implementation of the notification service that orchestrates the sending of notifications through various channels

classes.name: NotificationService
classes.description: Defines the contract for sending notifications through different channels

classes.name: NotificationRequest
classes.description: Data model representing a notification request with recipient, content, and channel information

classes.name: NotificationResponse
classes.description: Data model representing the response of a notification delivery attempt

classes.name: NotificationType
classes.description: Enumeration of different notification types (EMAIL, SMS, IN_APP)

classes.name: NotificationStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of notification delivery statuses (SENT, FAILED, PENDING)

classes.name: TemplateEngine
classes.description: Interface for processing notification templates and populating them with data

classes.name: TemplateEngineImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the template engine that processes notification templates
